# Progent: Programmable Privilege Control for LLM Agents
## 8 Related Work
#### Model-Level Prompt Injection Defenses
Another key distinction is that Progent provides deterministic security guarantees, which guardrail models cannot. Therefore, Progent can work synergistically with model-level defenses, where model defenses protect the core reasoning of the agent, Progent safeguards the execution boundary between the agent and external tools.
